title: Proof of physical units gap linear
html:
The archimedean normalisation 1/\hbar_q^2 in the mass formula buys back exactly two of the three vanishing orders of \Delta_q, and no more. It separates two rates that are easily conflated, and leaves a physical-units mass gap at first order in h.

Proof. Direct computation: \Delta_q / \hbar_q^2 = \tfrac{1}{2}(q - q^{-1})(q-1)^2 \cdot q^2/(q-1)^2 = \tfrac{1}{2}\,q^2\,(q - q^{-1}) = \tfrac{1}{2}\,q\,(q^2 - 1). \square

A mass gap in physical units is therefore a first-order-in-h phenomenon, in agreement with the first-order Reeb coupling (1 - q^{-1}) of the categorical Dirac operator. The identity is verified numerically to fifty digits in the witness q1-mass-gap-probe.witness.json.
